notes.title: First Release
notes.content:
Quick Announcement

3 on 3 Super Robot Hockey will be coming out April 5th, 2019!

Get ready for that date because it will be on sale initially.

notes.title: Welcome
notes.content:
I just want to greet everyone who just joined in! Welcome to our group I hope you will enjoy it here.

I've been working really hard making updates on the game for these past few days, and sent it to steam for review. Hopefully everything goes well.
